description: Estimate the fair value of one domain name with its low/high interval. A full cached appraisal includes its nearest recorded sales; catalog answers include only published fields. Otherwise a verified storedFigure can return the same public interval already in the report HTML, with source methodology, edition and artifact digest, but no scores, comparables or ODVS record. Use search_recorded_sales to browse sales and find_comparable_sales for just the five nearest sales. Deterministic: same name, same figure; confidence, when present, is an internal 0 to 100 score, not a probability. Without any cached, published or stored figure, returns no figure but a browser report link, 3 nearest published names for context and a next step. Cached answers, keyless catalog figures and public stored intervals use no API credits. A default-profile cache miss with an authorized write-scope paid API key (HTTP header Authorization: Bearer ad_live_...) can consume one API credit even for a catalog name, subject to allowance, rate limits and server budget. Rejected keyed runs can return an error. MCP cache hits use no API credits; without a key, catalog fallbacks are free. On the default profile a cache miss with an authorized write-scope paid key can consume one API credit even for a catalog name. Purchasing a current appraisal through an operator-funded agent account costs $0.03 per purchase (https://audit.domains/machine-account; live status, terms and protocol: GET https://audit.domains/api/machine/resolve). That is a separate paid purchase, not a charge for this MCP lookup. Fresh runs require write scope, remaining allowance and available server budget; card purchases use a hosted Square checkout.

domain.description: The one domain name to appraise, such as example.com. A pasted URL is accepted.

name: appraise_domain

agentTrial.description: Present with notAppraised (Lane 04, F4): free server-side fresh appraisals this caller can still claim (remaining) and how a trial is obtained (how). 0 with operator_required means an operator-issued grant is the only route today.

appraisal.description: Absent when storedFigure or notAppraised is present: no full appraisal was computed on this server for this response.

basis.description: Why this sale was matched, naming the channel the matcher scored on (shared keyword, word family, same industry, structural cohort, spelling, length/zone). null means the basis was not recorded - treat the match as unexplained rather than assuming a reason.

priceRange.description: The 1-2-5 band holding the recorded price (low inclusive, high exclusive). Exact recorded prices are not published on this free surface.

confidence.description: Internal 0-100 model score, NOT a probability.

certificate.description: Present with a figure while certificates are on sale: the checkout link (url) where the user buys a verifiable certificate of this appraisal, for a listing or a negotiation.

citeAs.description: A structured citation. Quote `text` or build your own from the fields. Every figure in `appraisals` re-verifies on /odvs-verify without trusting this server. Tools whose answer is not an appraisal (a bracket, which withholds estimates by contract, and the recorded-sales tools, whose rows are not hashed) return an empty `appraisals`. A stored interval also has no ODVS record: its artifact digest is provenance, not a standalone proof of these projected fields.

items.description: One appraisal holding exactly the fields its ODVS hashes commit to. Paste it into https://audit.domains/odvs-verify/ to recompute all three hashes client-side. appraisalHash is the appraisal's identity; resultDigest checks the output only.

confidence.description: Internal 0-100 model score, NOT a probability.

methodologyVersion.description: The methodology revision hashed into this record (as rev-<value>, or rev-n/a when null). It, not citeAs.revision, produced the figure.

edition.description: ODVS edition id; null until editions are published.

revision.description: The methodology revision live on the server at retrieval. A record's own methodologyVersion is what produced its figure and can differ.

nearestCatalog.description: Up to 3 published catalog names nearest the requested one, with their catalog figures. Context for the user, never the requested name's value.

next.description: Present with notAppraised: {tool, arguments} when a paid route to this name's figure is open on this server, otherwise the report link ({url}) that computes it in the reader's browser at no cost.

nextStep.description: One line on what to do next when no figure was computed.

notAppraised.description: The name that was not computed here. Not an error: open reportUrl, where the same engine runs in the reader's browser at no cost.

purchase.description: Present when this server sells a fresh appraisal by card: call the named tool to open a checkout for the user.

registration.description: Present with notAppraised: whether the name is registered, from live DNS and RDAP (status registered, unregistered, likely_unregistered or unknown).

storedFigure.description: Only the verified value interval already public in the report HTML, read from a stored canonical-engine result when no full MCP result or catalog figure is available. No scores, comparables or ODVS record. sha256 names the stored source artifact, not a standalone proof of this projection.

methodologyVersion.description: Active methodology configuration in the memo identity; a preserved payload method stamp can differ.

unattended.description: Present with notAppraised: how an agent gets a fresh figure with no person at purchase time, from a balance a person prepaid and a spending grant they issued. POST request; the 402 answer lists the purchase actions.

title: Appraise a domain name
